Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: At the initial search step, WebSurfer surfaced a misleading SERP snippet indicating Namie Amuro was born in “Nara, Nara Prefecture, Japan,” rather than verifying with an authoritative source. This premature reliance on a search snippet (and subsequent technical failures/loops accessing other sites) is an error pattern that could have led to an incorrect birthplace if taken at face value, contrasting with the correct, verified information (Naha, Okinawa).
